thread:
maria.garcia: Heads up — eu-west dedicated slice `slice-4f2` is spiking. p95 token latency jumped ~1.2s around 06:12 UTC and stays noisy. Seeing packet drops in the node telemetry. anyone oncall?
kevin_liu: oncall. pulling logs now. seeing lots of NIC queue growth + a few PCIe link resets on gpu-node-12.
kevin_liu: quick paste of syslog tail:
```
[06:11:58] kernel: mlx5_core 0000:04:00.0: firmware responded with error -11
[06:12:03] nvidia: dma-buf: pci_...: PCIe link down/up detected
[06:12:04] kubelet: Container runtime eviction: reclaiming memory from slice-4f2/tenant-x
```
devon: that smells like a DMA burst/noisy neighbor. any heavy memcpy/transfer jobs from tenant-x?
maria.garcia: tenant-x has a large batching job running but no deploys in the last hour. metrics show sustained PCIe retransmits during the spike.
ryan.sre: If it’s PCIe-level noise we'll see repeated migrations. Note that fallback to shared pool is happening automatically for a few allocations — cost and latency will both get worse. can we avoid automatic spill to shared?
kevin_liu: moving to disable soft-fallback on that slice to force either preemptible pool or drain instead: `kpools patch slice slice-4f2 --set softFallback=false`
kevin_liu: running command now.
infra-bot: APM: slice-4f2 softFallback toggled -> false by kevin_liu at 06:18 UTC.
maria.garcia: thanks. meanwhile i'll try to reprovision node and toggle NIC rx-queue coalescing. low-risk: `ethtool -C eth0 rx-usecs 200`
devon: can we also throttle tenant-x egress io via QoS tag until we confirm behavior? might prevent repeat bursts.
kevin_liu: applying temp qos tag `qos=softcap-low` to tenant-x, command: `kubectl annotate tenant tenant-x qos=softcap-low --overwrite`
kevin_liu: acked by pager: @pagerduty-bot incident-4721 acknowledged
pagerduty-bot: Alert 4721 acknowledged by kevin_liu
ryan.sre: monitoring p95 and node-level link errors. if p95 > 600ms after 10m we should drain node and reprovision; cc @capacity-team for spare node prep.
capacity-team: copy — prepping one spare GPU node in eu-west (estimated ready in 14m).
maria.garcia: will re-evaluate in 8m. if the NIC coalescing doesn't help, we'll drain gpu-node-12 and shift tenants off gracefully.
devon: note for postmortem: consider adding per-slice DMA burst detection metric (pci_retransmit_rate) + an automated soft-isolate policy to avoid costly shared fallbacks.
kevin_liu: agreed. temporary mitigation applied, keeping open until metrics stable. :thumbsup:
